management and retrieval. This project showcases the fundamentals of full -stack web development and database 
operations using the MERN stack.

AI Book Summarizer: 2025 
The AI Book Summarizer is a machine learning-based application that generates concise summaries from book or

meaningful summaries automatically. The system helps users save time by quickly understanding the key points of 
lengthy content. It provides a simple and user-friendly interface for uploading text and viewing the generated 
summary. 
Tech Stack: Streamlite, Python, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing

Event Management System is a basic full-stack web application developed using the MERN stack (MongoDB,
